Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Analyst based in Switzerland.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform complex gaming and player data into actionable insights that drive product performance, user engagement, and business growth. You will work at the intersection of data analytics, statistics, and data science, helping teams understand player behavior and uncover opportunities for product improvement. Through advanced analytical techniques, experimentation, and predictive modeling, you will identify key performance drivers and support data-informed decisions. You will collaborate closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers in a highly technical, data-driven environment. Your work will contribute to improving gaming experiences, validating product hypotheses, and developing innovative analytical solutions. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a product-oriented mindset and a passion for turning data into measurable business impact.

Accountabilities


Analyze large volumes of game and player data to identify patterns, trends, behavioral dynamics, and opportunities for business growth.
Translate analytical findings into actionable recommendations for product improvements, helping stakeholders understand what works, what does not, and where to focus next.
Conduct in-depth investigations into performance anomalies, game features, and changes in player behavior to determine underlying causes and explain their business implications.
Collaborate with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product Managers to develop hypotheses, validate assumptions, and contribute to hands-on data science and machine learning tasks.
Apply statistical analysis and causal inference techniques to identify the factors influencing user behavior and product performance.
Support predictive model development and validation through feature engineering, dataset preparation, model evaluation, and A/B testing.
Design and implement experiments, evaluate their results, and provide statistically sound recommendations to support product decisions.
Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and performance monitoring tools that help stakeholders track key performance indicators and make informed decisions.
Define and refine metrics for new products and features, translating high-level business requirements into measurable analytical frameworks.
Communicate complex analytical results clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Leverage AI coding assistants and other AI-powered tools to automate repetitive tasks, improve analytical workflows, and enhance the quality and efficiency of deliverables.


Requirements


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative discipline.
At least 5 years of experience as a Data Analyst or Data Scientist, preferably within the gaming, iGaming, or technology industry.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to uncover meaningful insights and translate data into clear business recommendations.
Experience working with large-scale datasets and distributed data processing technologies such as BigQuery, Spark, Hive, or equivalent tools.
Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, data transformation, and data wrangling.
Strong Python skills and practical experience with data science libraries such as pandas and scikit-learn.
Proficiency in data visualization and dashboard development using tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
Solid knowledge of experimental design, statistical testing, A/B testing, hypothesis testing, and confidence intervals.
Working knowledge of machine learning fundamentals, including supervised learning, feature engineering, model training and validation, and evaluation metrics.
Familiarity with causal inference and uplift modeling, along with practical experience contributing to machine learning workflows or model development in collaboration with Data Scientists.
Experience using AI coding assistants or other AI tools in daily work to improve automation, productivity, and output quality.
English proficiency at B2 level or above.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical findings to diverse audiences.
A proactive, product-oriented mindset and the ability to move beyond reporting metrics to recommend solutions that deliver measurable impact.


Nice To Have


Knowledge of the iGaming industry and an understanding of slot game mechanics.
The ability to evaluate games from the player's perspective and connect behavioral data with the overall gaming experience.
A strong product mindset, with an emphasis on identifying opportunities and proposing practical, impact-driven solutions.


Benefits


Flexible working hours and a remote-first working arrangement.
25 working days of annual vacation.
15 sick leave days.
One paid day off to celebrate your birthday.
Paid Ukrainian national holidays.
Medical insurance after successfully completing the three-month probation period.
A dedicated budget for professional development and education.
Company-funded individual English lessons.
Technical equipment tailored to your role and working needs.

Title: Operations Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for an Operations Data Analyst to support operational reporting, data quality and evidence-based decision-making within an international, mission-driven environment.

Working closely with operations, analytics and partnership teams, you will ensure the timely delivery of accurate and validated program data to support reporting commitments, partnership requirements and ad hoc analytical requests. You will work with data from institutional information systems and field sources, helping ensure consistency, reliability and transparency across reporting outputs.

This role combines strong technical expertise with cross-functional collaboration, requiring an analytical mindset, excellent organizational skills and the ability to translate complex datasets into meaningful insights.




Key responsibilities

Data reporting and delivery: Maintain reporting schedules and coordinate the timely submission of validated program data to internal stakeholders and external partners.
Data extraction and validation: Extract, consolidate and verify program data from multiple information systems and field sources, ensuring consistency with official reporting figures and published reports.
Data quality and standards: Apply agreed indicator definitions and data disaggregation frameworks. Document data sources, methodologies, assumptions and limitations where relevant.
Partnership support: Contribute to the review of partnership proposals and results frameworks, assessing their alignment with program priorities, indicator feasibility and data availability.
Data protection and confidentiality: Ensure that all externally shared data complies with applicable data protection policies and confidentiality requirements.
Stakeholder coordination: Act as a key point of contact for operational data and reporting requests, working closely with headquarters and field-based colleagues.
Advanced analytics and data science: Support operational teams through tailored analytical solutions, advanced data processing and the development of data science applications.




Requirements

University degree in data analytics, statistics, information management or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, monitoring, reporting or a related field.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel; working knowledge of Power BI is an advantage.
Understanding of monitoring and reporting concepts, including output and outcome indicators, logical frameworks and data disaggregation.
Intermediate Python skills, ideally including the integration of AI models into applications through APIs.
Familiarity with applying AI models to large-scale data tasks, such as classification, information extraction and summarization.
Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
Previous experience in an international, humanitarian or development context, or in donor reporting, is an asset.




Desired profile and competencies

Strong analytical, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to communicate complex findings clearly through effective data storytelling.
Excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to data quality.
Ability to work autonomously, prioritize tasks and deliver results within deadlines.
Strong communication and active listening skills.
Experience collaborating with multicultural and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
A collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented approach.
Genuine interest in humanitarian action and the use of data to support operational impact.

Title: Junior Business Data Analyst
Description:
PIX4D is seeking a talented Business Data Analyst to bridge Finance, Product Management and Commercial Operations (Sales and Marketing), develop complex analytical tools to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes. You will be a member of PIX4D's dynamic Finance team, in a hybrid work environment, based in Lausanne, Switzerland.




In this cross-functional role, you will query complex datasets, build dashboards, define KPIs, and translate emerging trends into actionable insights for stakeholders. You will balance data integrity with commercial impact, transforming raw data into insights that support high-level strategic decisions.




Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Reporting: Cleaning, manipulating, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies
Dashboard Development: Creating interactive dashboards and reports using dashboarding tools and leveraging AI-powered tools for enhanced automation and visualization
AI & Automation: Leveraging Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to streamline data workflows and enhance intelligent decision-making
Database Querying: Using SQL to extract and prepare data from various systems
Actionable Insights: Translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for business growth, efficiency, and optimization
Stakeholder Collaboration: Working with cross-functional teams to define business requirements and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Data Governance: Ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and standardization.




Requirements

Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, Excel (advanced), and experience using data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)
AI Proficiency: Familiarity with Generative AI, Agentic AI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementations
Analytical Abilities: Strong statistical knowledge, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail
Communication: Ability to tell a story with data to non-technical stakeholders
Education/Experience: A master's degree in business, economics, statistics, or data analytics, coupled with a first experience in supporting data-driven decisions.




What We Offer

Exciting work with cutting-edge technology in an international company
Well-located office near Lausanne, with easy access by public transport
Flexible working hours and hybrid work possibility
25 days of paid vacation
Employee Assistance Program with Lyra providing Mental, Legal and Financial assistance
Contribution to local sports events
Discounts for local stores, restaurants and other services
Company Social Events
Learning and professional development opportunities




Working environment

PIX4D is a unique, fun, and intellectually stimulating company where you can grow and excel in your field. Our environment is authentic and multicultural, a place where we respect and learn from each other in the pursuit of being the best at what we do. Get more information here.




Recruitment

PIX4D promotes diversity and offers opportunities across all levels and career paths in all of its offices regardless of gender, race, or religion. We use standardized and structured interviews to ensure all candidates are treated equally and avoid any discrimination.




Company

When you work at PIX4D, you empower professionals worldwide to digitize reality through survey-grade georeferenced 2D maps and 3D models. These outputs can be measured, analyzed, and shared, all based on data from images taken by plane, drone, or mobile phone.

We build solutions that take advantage of technology including reality capture, computer vision, digital twins, and machine learning to help solve our customers' most complex challenges.




Founded in 2011, PIX4D has its headquarters in Lausanne, Switzerland and commercial and R&D offices in Denver, Berlin, Tokyo, Bucharest and Madrid.




Additional Information

All our candidate applications are screened by humans and not an AI recruiter.

Title: Staff Data Analyst
Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Data Analyst based in Switzerland.

As a Staff Data Analyst, you will take ownership of analytics across a global travel marketplace, shaping how product, engineering, and commercial teams use data to drive strategic decisions. You will be the first dedicated analytics owner for this business area, building reliable data foundations and transforming complex customer, booking, and API usage data into actionable insights. Working directly with senior stakeholders, you will influence product priorities, identify growth opportunities, and establish trusted metrics across the business. You will combine strategic thinking with hands-on analytics engineering, developing data models, pipelines, and analytical products from concept to implementation. You will also help introduce product analytics and experimentation capabilities to better understand customer behavior and improve adoption and conversion. This is an opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-moving, international environment where autonomy, technical excellence, and business outcomes matter.

Accountabilities


Own analytics across the customer-facing business, covering enterprise partners, self-service customers, API adoption, booking performance, and commercial outcomes.
Partner closely with senior Product, Engineering, and commercial leaders to define analytical priorities, challenge assumptions, and translate business questions into data-driven decisions.
Build, validate, and maintain reliable dbt models, data pipelines, and analytical products that consolidate fragmented data sources into consistent, trusted reporting.
Establish standardized metrics and reporting frameworks to resolve discrepancies between dashboards and provide a reliable view of product and business performance.
Analyze customer journeys, API usage, and booking behavior to identify friction points, uncover conversion opportunities, and improve customer activation and retention.
Develop product analytics capabilities and introduce experimentation frameworks, including hypothesis development, experiment design, and performance measurement.
Investigate complex marketplace data across multiple products, systems, and fragmented hotel supply networks to uncover trends, operational challenges, and growth opportunities.
Take analytical initiatives from initial discovery and solution design through implementation, validation, and adoption, ensuring that data products deliver measurable business value.
Use AI coding agents and automation tools to accelerate development and analysis while maintaining data quality, reliability, and technical standards.
Operate independently in an evolving environment, prioritizing high-impact opportunities, defining solutions with limited specifications, and delivering results with minimal oversight.
Help shape analytics practices, data standards, and ways of working as the wider data organization continues to develop.


Requirements


Extensive experience in data analytics, analytics engineering, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of independently owning complex analytical initiatives.
Proven experience working closely with senior Product, Engineering, or business leaders, influencing decisions through clear insights and a strong understanding of commercial priorities.
Strong hands-on expertise in analytics engineering, including designing, developing, and validating dbt models, data pipelines, and end-to-end analytical solutions.
Demonstrated ability to transform fragmented or complex datasets into reliable, well-structured data products that stakeholders can confidently use.
Strong understanding of product analytics, customer behavior, conversion funnels, API adoption, and the relationship between product performance and business outcomes.
Experience working in startups or scaleups, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and deliver meaningful results in environments with limited structure.
Practical experience using AI coding agents or AI-powered development tools to improve productivity, automate workflows, and accelerate implementation without compromising quality.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate complex questions, identify root causes, and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
A high degree of autonomy, ownership, and accountability, combined with the ability to connect individual analytical projects to broader business and product objectives.


Nice To Have


Experience with product analytics and experimentation, including designing experiments and evaluating their impact on customer adoption, conversion, and growth.
Background in marketplace businesses, platform companies, travel technology, or other complex, multi-sided digital ecosystems.
Experience consolidating data across multiple products, systems, and customer segments to establish consistent performance metrics.
Familiarity with AI-driven product development and modern data workflows.


Benefits


Remote and hybrid flexibility: Work remotely within the EU or choose a hybrid arrangement in Barcelona, Palma de Mallorca, Dublin, or London.
High ownership and autonomy: Take responsibility for a major analytics function and directly influence strategic product and business decisions.
Meaningful business impact: Build foundational analytics capabilities and see your work inform real decisions, product improvements, and commercial growth.
Fast-paced working environment: Benefit from streamlined processes, limited bureaucracy, and the ability to move quickly from ideas to implementation.
International collaboration: Work with distributed teams and senior stakeholders across multiple countries and functions.
Professional growth: Help establish analytics practices and contribute to the evolution of a growing data organization.
AI-driven innovation: Use modern AI tools and technologies to accelerate analytical development and improve operational efficiency.
Major market opportunity: Contribute to technology that addresses complex challenges across the global travel and B2B hotel ecosystem.


How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Le consultant intégrera une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de collaborateurs internes et externes, et interviendra dans le cadre d'un programme de modernisation de l'environnement de reporting et d'analyse de données. Le besoin est principalement orienté Data Analysis et Power BI, avec une dimension d'évolution progressive vers des sujets d'industrialisation et de transformation de l'architecture Data.


Vos missions :

  • Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions de reporting adaptées
  • Concevoir et développer des rapports et dashboards Power BI
  • Construire des visualisations pertinentes et orientées utilisateurs
  • Développer des mesures et indicateurs en DAX
  • Préparer et transformer les données avec Power Query
  • Participer à la définition et à la mise en œuvre des KPI
  • Construire et faire évoluer les modèles de données Power BI
  • Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la performance des rapports


Votre profil :

  • Expérience significative en Data / BI avec une maîtrise confirmée de Power BI
  • Bonne maîtrise de DAX et de Power Query
  • Connaissances solides en SQL et en modélisation de données
  • Compréhension des modèles de données en étoile
  • Autonomie, capacité d'analyse et recul sur les problématiques Data
  • Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes Data et des parties prenantes métier
  • Curiosité et volonté de monter en compétence sur des sujets d'architecture Data

Title: Business Data Analyst Hotel (d/w/m) 80-100%
Description:
Stellenbeschreibung:



Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von Data & Analytics in unserem stark wachsenden Hotelbereich mit. Gemeinsam mit Revenue Management und operativer Führung entwickelst du Lösungen, die Entscheidungen unterstützen und neue Potenziale sichtbar machen.

Das bewegst du
Du entwickelst Hotel-Analytics weiter und übersetzt Fragestellungen aus Revenue Management und operativer Führung in aussagekräftige Analysen, Handlungsempfehlungen und konkrete Datenlösungen
Du erstellst und optimierst Power-BI-Berichte und Dashboards, die Zusammenhänge verständlich machen und die Hotelsteuerung unterstützen
Gemeinsam mit den Data Engineers entwickelst du Datenmodelle und Kennzahlen weiter, verbindest operative mit finanziellen Daten und stellst die fachliche Datenqualität sicher
Du unterstützt Hotelverantwortliche und Key User dabei, Daten selbstständig zu nutzen und Erkenntnisse in ihre Entscheidungen einzubeziehen
Das bringst du mit
Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der selbstständigen Umsetzung von Power-BI-Lösungen inklusive Datenmodellierung sowie sichere DAX-Kenntnisse
Erfahrung in der Hotelbranche und ein tiefes Verständnis für Hotelprozesse, Revenue Management und Kennzahlen
Aus- oder Weiterbildung in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaft, Data Analytics oder einem verwandten Bereich – oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil
Das zeichnet dich aus
Analytisches Denken
Empathie und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
Innovation und Kreativität
Dein Einsatzort

Was dich bei uns erwartet? Ein Arbeitsplatz, der sich deinem Leben anpasst. Unser Remote-Konzept ermöglicht dir flexibles Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro im Herzen von Dübendorf oder direkt in unseren gastronomischen Betrieben und Hotels.

Der Standort bietet dir beste ÖV-Anbindung, moderne Infrastruktur, ein hauseigenes Mitarbeiterrestaurant und kurze Entscheidungswege. Hier arbeitest du im Herzen der Organisation – mit direktem Draht zum Team und viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung.

Mit „The Way We Work“ schaffen wir bei SV Group eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Offenheit und des Wachstums. Eigenverantwortung, konstruktives Feedback und klare Entscheidungen sichern unseren Erfolg. In deiner Rolle begleitest du das Team mit Hands-on-Mentalität, Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Vorwärtsdenken und Herzlichkeit – so entwickeln alle ihre Stärken weiter und wir schaffen gemeinsam unvergessliche Erlebnisse für unsere Gäste.

Das bieten wir dir - unter anderem

Schlemmen: Kostenlose, frische und gesunde Mitarbeitendenverpflegung
Vergünstigungen: Mitarbeitenden-Raten in den SV geführten Hotels und vergünstigtes Essen in unseren Restaurants
Entlohnung: Branchen- und marktgerechtes Salär und 13. Monatslohn
Flexibilität: Gleitzeitmodell, Remote Work, Teilzeitarbeit und Jobsharing möglich
Familienfreundlich: 5 Wochen Ferien, Kauf von zusätzlichen Ferien möglich, 16 Wochen Mutterschaftsurlaub
Prämie und Gutscheine: Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Geschenke zu Jubiläum und Geburtstagen
Entwicklung: SV Academy mit knapp 300 Schulungen, Kursen, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und E-Learnings
Weitere Benefits: Diverse Vergünstigungen (z.B. bei Sunrise, Reka, Migrol, Fleurop, Kollektivversicherung CSS/Helsana)

Title: Senior Specialist - HD Analytics & Reporting
Description:
In Short




Our Happiness Delivery (HD) team is growing, and we are looking for an Analytics & Reporting Senior Specialist to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights.

You will sit at the intersection of business, analytics and data engineering, helping HD understand its performance, improve how we use data and identify opportunities to work smarter through automation and technology.

This is not just a reporting role. You will be a curious problem solver and trusted analytics partner who can move from a business question to the underlying data, understand what is happening, and translate the answer into a simple and actionable story for the right audience.




Your Mission




Own the Performance Narrative: Design, build and maintain dashboards and reporting that provide a clear view of HD performance across regions, channels and processes. Ensure that metrics are accurate, relevant and presented at the right level of granularity for different stakeholders.
Turn Business Questions into Insights: Partner with HD leadership and operational teams to understand their questions and translate them into meaningful analysis, KPIs and reporting. Go beyond reporting what happened to help explain why it happened and what we should do about it.
Bridge Business and Data Engineering: Act as a strong link between HD and Data Engineering / Business Intelligence teams. Translate business needs into clear data requirements, help clarify priorities and investigate issues when reporting or data does not behave as expected.
Look Beyond the Dashboard: You are comfortable going deeper into the data pipeline when necessary. You will investigate data quality issues, understand how data is transformed, identify gaps or inconsistencies and provide recommendations on where the underlying data or processes can be improved.
Continuously Improve: Challenge existing ways of working and identify opportunities to simplify reporting, automate flows, improve data structures, reduce manual effort and strengthen the overall analytics landscape. Help the team move from reactive reporting towards scalable, proactive analytics.




Your Story




Analytical Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, performance management, customer service, CRM, operations or a related field. Experience in customer service is a strong plus, and you understand the importance of translating operational performance into actionable insights.
Strong Technical Foundation: You are highly proficient in SQL and comfortable working with data logic and transformations. You can investigate data beyond the reporting layer and understand how data flows through a pipeline. Experience with LookML is desirable, and Python is a plus.
BI & Data Visualization: You have strong hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools. You understand not only how to build dashboards, but how to structure information and visualizations so that complex performance can be communicated clearly to different audiences. Experience with Looker and HEX is a strong plus.
AI & Automation Mindset: You are curious about AI and modern automation technologies and naturally look for opportunities to eliminate manual work, improve processes and scale analytics. Experience measuring or working with AI/automation initiatives, such as automation rates, model accuracy or human intervention, is a plus.
Curious Problem Solver: You enjoy investigating problems rather than accepting the first answer. When a number looks wrong, a process is inefficient or a stakeholder has a difficult question, you are comfortable digging into the data and underlying logic to understand what is really happening.
Business & Technical Translator: You are able to translate business needs into data requirements for engineering teams, while also explaining technical concepts and data limitations in a simple way to business stakeholders.You can challenge assumptions constructively, align different perspectives and turn ambiguous business questions into clear analytical requirements.
Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science, data analytics, business analytics or a related quantitative field.
Language Skills: Business fluency in English is required.




Your Team




At On, delivering happiness is not just a phrase, it’s a mission. That’s why we call our customer service organization Happiness Delivery.

You will join an entrepreneurial and ambitious team where analytics plays a key role in improving how we serve our customers and operate at scale. You will work closely with HD leadership, operational teams, Analytics & Reporting, Data Engineering and other technology partners across Berlin, Zurich and Portland.

This is an opportunity to have a tangible impact on how HD uses data: from strengthening the foundations of our reporting to identifying new opportunities to automate, simplify and improve the customer experience.

Title: Regulatory Data Analyst (80-100%)
Description:
Do you want to contribute to the integrity and transparency of Swiss financial markets through data-driven surveillance and regulatory oversight?
Within SIX Exchange Regulation, the Surveillance Assurance & Development team is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities, data quality and the evolution of surveillance systems and methodologies.
As a Regulatory Data Analyst, you will act as the subject matter expert for Transaction Reporting under MiFID II (RTS 22) and Swiss FMIA requirements and help ensure that Transaction Reporting data is complete, accurate and fit for surveillance, compliance and enforcement purposes. You will work closely with Surveillance, Enforcement & Compliance and IT teams and contribute to the ongoing development of surveillance capabilities and data quality.

 

What You Will Do  
Act as the subject matter expert for Transaction Reporting, including MiFID II (RTS 22) and Swiss FMIA reporting requirements.
Analyze transaction reporting data, perform data quality reviews and investigate reporting deficiencies, anomalies and completeness issues.
Conduct analyses based on transaction reporting data and provide expert support to surveillance, compliance and enforcement activities, including investigations, requests from regulatory and supervisory authorities, and reporting-related assessments.
Provide Transaction Reporting expertise and contribute to surveillance initiatives, regulatory changes, system enhancements and continuous improvement of transaction reporting data quality in collaboration with business and IT stakeholders.
What You Bring 
University degree in Economics, Finance, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience in finance, capital markets or stock exchange environments. Good understanding of trading activities and financial instruments (e.g. equities, bonds, ETFs, warrants and derivatives). Experience in regulatory transaction reporting is a strong advantage.
Strong analytical mindset and good SQL and Python knowledge with the ability to analyze, investigate and validate large datasets. Experience with Databricks and PySpark is an advantage.
High attention to detail, proactive working style and strong communication skills.
Fluent English is required; German language skills are an advantage.

Du entscheidest, wohin sich die Plattform entwickelt, und machst aus Sensordaten von Bahnhöfen, Velowegen und Retailflächen Erkenntnisse, die Städte und Unternehmen weiterbringen.

Du führst die Diamond App:





Du verantwortest Roadmap, Backlog und Releases unserer BI- und Reporting Plattform.


Du gestaltest die Nutzererfahrung und entscheidest, wo KI-Funktionen echten Mehrwert bringen.

Du bist nah and Kunden und Technik:





Du unterstützt Akquise und Key Account Management mit deinem technischen Know-how.


Du spezifizierst und testest Datenlösungen bis zur Abnahme.


Du entwickelst Algorithmen (z.B. Map-Matching, Flussmodelle) weiter und sorgst für die Qualität der IoT-Sensordaten.









Qualifikation




Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit starker Kommunikation und vermittelst zwischen Entwicklung, Analyse und Kundschaft. Dabei hast du Freude am Kundenkontakt und bereitest komplexe Analysen so auf, dass sie auch Nicht-Fachleute überzeugen. Konkret bringst du dafür mit:





Abgeschlossenes Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science oder einem verwandten Bereich


Erfahrung als Product Owner im BI- oder Datenumfeld und mit agilen Methoden sowie in der Spezifikation und im Testen von Datenlösungen, in Datenmodellen und Datenpipelines


Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python, R oder SQL und in BI-Werkzeugen (z.B. Superset, Power BI)


Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch ist ein Plus


Kenntnisse in Statistik und Verkehrsflussmodellierung sowie Erfahrung in der technischen Verkaufsunterstützung sind von Vorteil









Benefits




Was wir bieten





Produktverantwortung für eine eigene Plattform mit grossem Gestaltungsspielraum


Relevante Projekte mit realen Daten aus Bahnhöfen, Velowegen und Retailflächen


Flache Hierarchien und ein interdisziplinäres Team in Zürich

HTML:
Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As a Senior Regulatory Data Analyst (w/m/d), you will report to the Registration & Compliance Lead. The lead is part of the Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE. You will work within our Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE, specifically in the Registration & Compliance department. This department is located at our Vernier site in Switzerland.

You will provide subject matter expertise with chemical regulatory compliance, chemical management and carry out compliance monitoring reviews to ensure the business is meeting its regulatory obligations and risks are avoided.

You will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with all chemical control legislations.

In This Exciting Role You Will

  • Perform compliance monitoring on CCL (Chemical Control Legislation) to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards and outcomes;
  • Collaborate with the RAPS team and business stakeholders to finalise reports for presentation and submission to relevant boards and sub-committees, following the requirements of the plan, including impact analysis for decision making;
  • Provide analyses for large datasets necessary for decisions using relevant insights;
  • Attend sub-committee's sessions to present findings and recommendations;
  • Support the review/update/development of the regulatory/compliance policies and procedures to ensure they remain appropriate, relevant and effective;
  • Participate to the development of the solutions to ensure of the compliance globally, the testing and the training of the teams;
  • Define and deliver metrics, reporting platforms, dashboards for tracking and managing compliance;
  • Track monitoring actions to successful resolution;
  • Identify business challenges and initiate process improvement projects;
  • Facilitate the computerization of analytics and data collection processes.

Your Professional Profile Includes

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific field;
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant in a compliance role in chemical or related industry;
  • Proficient knowledge of BI, SAP, or other business Intelligence tools; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint;
  • Familiarity with programming languages (e.g: Python, Javascript, SQL) and AI is beneificial;
  • Strong analytical skills;
  • Knowledge of CCL regulatory requirements and legal guidelines is beneficial;
  • Business fluency in English and French is a must;
  • Experience supporting cross functional groups and teams

Our Benefits

  • Healthcare support
  • Paid Time Off and family leave
  • Retirement plan
  • Sport and leisure clubs
  • Company shop
  • Staff restaurant
  • Corporate Mobility Plan

At Givaudan, you contribute to delightful taste and scent experiences that touch people’s lives.

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.

Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment

Conversion rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Sales per square meter / selling space
Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.

Replenishment

Inventory optimization

Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.

Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique

Analyze:

Price architecture

Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.

Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.

Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.

Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions

5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.

Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).

Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.

Extraktion, Analyse, Aufbereitung und Visualisierung FINMA-spezifischer Daten sowie Erstellung entsprechender Berichte

Company

Ameropa, founded in 1948, is a Swiss, privately owned international agri-business focused on producing, originating, and marketing fertilizers and grains. As part of the global supply chain, Ameropa contributes to feeding communities around the world. The company’s headquarters are in Binningen, Switzerland, near Basel, with regional offices across all five continents. About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and curious Junior Grains Analyst to join our Grains & Oilseeds division. Based in our Lausanne office, this role offers an excellent opportunity to gain exposure to global agricultural markets and develop expertise in market analysis, commodity trading, and international agribusiness.




Key Responsibilities

Support the analysis of global grains and oilseeds markets
Monitor market developments, crop conditions, supply and demand fundamentals, weather events, trade flows, and macroeconomic trends
Collect, organize, and analyse market data from various sources
Assist in the preparation of market reports, presentations, and management updates
Work closely with traders, and commercial teams to support business decision-making
Contribute to the development and maintenance of dashboards, reporting tools, and business intelligence solutions
Support projects related to data analytics, artificial intelligence, and process improvements
Develop knowledge of agricultural commodities, trading activities, and international markets




Profile / Requirements

Master's degree (or final year of studies) in Agronomy, Agricultural Economics, Economics, Business Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline

Title: Business Performance & Data Analytics Project Manager
Description:
HOW WILL YOU MAKE AN IMPACT?

Within the Watch & Jewelry Industrial Department, you will support the leadership team in preparing strategic materials, steering performance and managing cross-functional projects, with a strong focus on data analytics, performance monitoring and digital tools.

As a true partner to the leadership team, you will transform data into relevant insights, produce analyses that support decision-making and prepare executive-level communication materials by turning complex data into actionable analysis and decision-support content.

By combining strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in digital tools, Business Intelligence and approved Artificial Intelligence solutions, you will help improve the quality, speed and effectiveness of analysis and decision-making within W&J Industrial Management.

A key priority will be to structure and consolidate the department's data, develop relevant and reliable KPIs and implement efficient, increasingly automated reporting tools. As you develop your understanding of the business and its priorities, you will progressively contribute to the monitoring and coordination of strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Performance Management


Collect, consolidate, clean and structure data from multiple sources.
Map existing data sources and reporting processes and establish consistent data structures and definitions across the department.
Structure, organize and maintain the department's internal folder hierarchy and shared documentation, ensuring consistency, accessibility and efficient information management.
Conduct quantitative and qualitative analyses to identify trends, gaps and improvement opportunities.
Define, implement and enhance key performance indicators (KPIs) and dashboards to support effective performance monitoring.
Ensure data reliability, consistency, accessibility and traceability.
Design charts and visualizations that make results easier to understand.
Develop and automate data consolidation, reporting processes and analytical tools to improve efficiency and reduce manual work.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of performance management tools.


Strategic Support to Industrial Department


Support leadership team members in preparing meetings, performance reviews and strategic materials.
Contribute to the follow-up of priority projects and action plans.
Coordinate information gathering across the different functions and our Manufactures (MCCs).
Monitor selected cross-functional projects.
Progressively take a more active role in the coordination and follow-up of strategic initiatives as your business understanding and responsibilities develop.


Preparation of Presentations and Strategic Documents


Develop PowerPoint presentations for Management Committees, the Executive Committee, or General Management.
Turn complex information into simple, structured and visually impactful messages.
Contribute to drafting executive summaries, strategic memos and decision-support documents.
Structure information to highlight key issues, risks, opportunities and recommendations.
Ensure a high standard of visual and editorial quality across deliverables.
Leverage data visualization and Business Intelligence tools to produce clear, reliable and impactful management reporting.


HOW WILL YOU EXPERIENCE SUCCESS WITH US?


You hold a Master's degree or equivalent from a business school, engineering school, or university, ideally with a strong analytical or data-oriented background.
You have 2 to 5 years of professional experience in consulting, business analysis, business intelligence, strategy, management control, or a similar function.
You have excellent command of Microsoft Office, Microsoft 365, Copilot and related tools. Advanced Excel skills and hands-on experience with data structuring, Power Query and Power BI are highly valued. Knowledge of SQL, Python, Looker, GCP, or other Business Intelligence and automation tools is an advantage.
You have a strong interest in digital tools and Artificial Intelligence and genuinely enjoy exploring, building and improving analytical solutions.
You combine strong analytical and synthesis skills with intellectual curiosity, rigor and excellent organizational abilities.
You are comfortable working with complex datasets and transforming fragmented information into structured, reliable and actionable insights.
You demonstrate excellent written communication skills and can work effectively under tight deadlines.
You are autonomous, proactive, discreet and service-oriented, with a strong internal customer focus.
You are a collaborative team player who can work with stakeholders at all levels and are motivated to learn and develop new skills.
You are eager to progressively broaden your responsibilities towards strategic project monitoring and coordination.


WHAT MAKES OUR GROUP DIFFERENT?

Our true power does not lie in our similarities but in the rich diversity of our arts, cultures, and human skills, as well as our specific ability to foster untapped potential.


We value collegiality, empathy, curiosity, courage, humility, and integrity.
We care for the world we live in.


YOUR JOURNEY WITH US

If your application is selected, we will reach out shortly for an introductory call.

As part of the interview process, we always ensure complete insight and transparency. Namely, you will have the chance to meet people who will be crucial to your future success in the role.

Title: Analytics & Insights Manager
Description:
Join our dynamic corporate team and become part of Aman Group. With offices strategically located around the world (Zug, London, Dubai, Singapore, Bangkok, Miami and New York), our corporate colleagues are at the forefront of driving innovation and excellence for our ultra-luxury brand.

Role:

We are seeking an Analytics & Insights Manager reporting to the Director of Analytics & Insights. Based in our Baar, Switzerland corporate office you will lead data analysis, reporting, and dashboarding across the business. This role will transform complex data into actionable insights, oversee end-to-end data processes, and ensure accuracy across core systems. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to align on KPIs, support strategic decision-making, and foster a strong data-driven culture.

Responsibilities:


Oversee daily data ingestion, synchronization, and validation processes across internal (CRM, PMS, Finance) and external data sources (vendors, partners, market feeds)
Ensure all data pipelines and manual uploads are executed accurately and on schedule
Coordinate with Data Engineering to troubleshoot data discrepancies, failed loads, or system mismatches
Collaborate with Data Engineering to ensure data readiness, consistency, and governance across CRM, PMS, and ancillary systems
Validate and maintain the integrity of datasets, ensuring alignment with enterprise data standards and with data privacy / compliance / governance requirements
Conduct deep-dive analyses and develop predictive models (e.g., seasonality, demand forecasting, pricing performance, customer engagement)
Partner with global and regional stakeholders to define and maintain standardized KPIs (e.g., occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, GOP, channel mix)
Own the end-to-end development of dashboards and reporting frameworks in PBI for hotel performance across regions
Ensure metrics for business performance are defined, measured, and maintained consistently across teams to support scalability and transparency
Partner with Commercial and Operations teams to identify performance drivers and opportunities across markets, lines of business, and properties Translate recurring requirements of commercial and operational teams into automated, self-service dashboards
Deliver actionable insights on revenue trends, booking behaviour and operational efficiency


Requirements:


Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
6 -8 years of experience in customer analytics, data science, or business intelligence, preferably within luxury hospitality, travel, or consumer sectors
Demonstrated expertise in predictive modelling and business analysis
Proficiency in SQL and Power BI required; experience with Python, R, or statistical modeling tools preferred
Experience with DBT, GitHub and Snowflake
Experience integrating data from CRM, PMS, and external sources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate insights to senior stakeholders
Deep understanding of data governance, privacy compliance, and analytical best practices


Benefits

At Aman Group, we believe our colleagues are at the core of our success. We offer competitive benefits, including exciting global career opportunities within a rapidly expanding company. We prioritize and support your professional journey, ensuring you feel valued, included, and at home.

If you are passionate about attracting exceptional talent and creating a positive experience for every candidate, we invite you to apply to join us on our journey.

Title: Spécialiste controlling et reportings crédits
Description:
Et si votre histoire professionnelle se poursuivait à la BCV ?

Mettez vos ambitions managériales au service d’une performance saine et durable en rejoignant la première banque universelle du canton de Vaud, l’une des banques les plus solides au monde, et ses quelque 2000 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Prenez part au succès d’une institution notée AA par Standard & Poor’s depuis 2011 et contribuez à l’essor du tissu économique vaudois ainsi qu’à l’attractivité et à la vitalité de notre région.

Pour notre département Stratégie et Organisation, nous recherchons un ou une :

Spécialiste controlling et reportings crédits 60 à 100%

Vos missions


Produire les reportings à destination des entités internes (Département, Direction générale, Conseil d'administration) et externes (Finma, BNS), en utilisant des outils comme RStudio/R
Assurer le bon fonctionnement des End User Computings (EUCs) (en Access/VBA) du département et apporter un support interne à la Division pour ces développements.
Optimiser les sources d'information internes et externes afin de fournir au Département, à la Division et à la Banque des données fiables et pertinentes.
Assurer le controlling du Département Support crédits : analyses liées au suivi des risques crédits (monitoring, dépassements/découverts, etc.) et établissement des statistiques.
Détecter les opportunités de simplification et proposer des améliorations de procédures sur la base d'une analyse quantitative, objective et financière.
Participer à des groupes de travail (IT et/ou processus), voire les conduire, et contribuer à l'analyse de la situation actuelle et future.
Rendre compte de l'avancement des projets à la hiérarchie, en mettant en évidence les risques (budget, délais).


Votre profil


Formation supérieure en ingénierie, en informatique, finance ou sciences (EPF, HES ou équivalent).
Au minimum 1 an d'expérience professionnelle ; une expérience dans le reporting bancaire est un atout.
Aisance avec la programmation (RStudio/R, Python); connaissances d'Access/VBA, SQL souhaitées.
Aisance avec le requêtage et la manipulation de données.
Esprit d'analyse, sens du détail et orientation solution.
Volonté d'optimiser les processus existants.
Personnalité agréable, à l'aise dans un travail d'équipe.
Parfaite maîtrise du français et bon niveau d'anglais


Si ce poste est fait pour vous, postulez dès maintenant et participez à l’avenir prometteur de la BCV. Ecrivons ensemble trois histoires, celle de votre carrière, celle de votre banque, celle de notre région.

80-100%

Title: Data Analytics Specialist
Description:
Bring your talent, expertise and personality to international standardization and conformity assessment, and embark on a journey with us to make the world a safer and more sustainable place.




Become our next:

Data Analytics Specialist 100% based in Geneva

Head of Back Office Solutions and Data




About the Role

You will design and operate the analytics layer of IEC’s enterprise Data Platform hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), transforming operational data into trusted analytical datasets, dashboards, and reusable data assets to enable self-service reporting and support data-driven decision-making.




In this role, you will contribute to business data modelling, KPI definition, and the development of reporting solutions that provide a single source of truth for IEC data and collaborate with business stakeholders and IT teams to deliver scalable and governed analytical assets.




You will also support the development of high-quality, AI-ready data products aligned with IEC’s data strategy and future advanced analytics initiatives.




Responsibilities

Data analytics platform design

design and maintain the analytics architecture of IEC’s Data Platform
structure analytical datasets within the Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW)
build and maintain semantic data models supporting dashboards and reporting tools
ensure the platform provides a single source of truth for business data

Business data modelling

define and structure core business entities and relationships
design data models that support consistent KPI definitions across dashboards
collaborate with IEC Secretariat to validate business logic and metrics

Dashboard & analytics development

design and build interactive dashboards and reports using Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC) and Microsoft Power BI
develop standardized dashboards for key organizational use cases
create reusable datasets, visualizations, and dashboard templates
ensure dashboards are intuitive, reliable, and aligned with business needs

Self-Service reporting enablement

enable departments to create and adapt their own dashboards through self-service BI capabilities
build shared datasets and semantic layers accessible to business users
develop a library of reusable BI templates and reporting datasets
train and support business teams in using analytics tools effectively

Data quality & governance

implement processes to ensure data quality, reliability, and consistency
monitor and report on data quality metrics and anomalies
maintain business definitions and metadata using a business glossary and data catalog
ensure proper data lineage and documentation across analytical datasets
support compliance with data governance and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR)

Data integration for analytics

work with IT teams to integrate data from multiple enterprise systems
support data ingestion processes using OCI Data Integration and Oracle Data Transform

Title: Data & MarTech Manager | Analytics, Automation & CRM
Description:
Wir bauen den digitalsten Büromöbel-Brand Europas.




ofinto ist der digitale Herausforderer im Büromöbelmarkt. Wir entwickeln ergonomische Büromöbel und verkaufen sie direkt an Privat- und Geschäftskunden in der Schweiz, in Deutschland, Österreich und Frankreich. Über 100'000 Kundinnen und Kunden haben bei uns bestellt. Nun suchen wir den nächsten Wachstumsschritt - mit einem dynamischen Team, das KI und Automationen im Alltag nutzt.




Als Data & MarTech Manager machst du aus unseren Zahlen Entscheide: Welcher Kanal lohnt sich, was bringen Plakat und TV, wo setzen Marketing und Vertrieb als Nächstes an. Du ziehst die Analysen selbst, baust mit SQL, n8n und KI-Werkzeugen wie Claude die Pipelines und Automationen dazu und sorgst dafür, dass Tracking und CRM die richtigen Daten liefern. Du berichtest an Jonas, unseren Mitgründer.





Standort: Büro in 8005 Zürich, 3 Gehminuten vom HB, mindestens 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort


Start: sofort oder nach Vereinbarung


Pensum: 80-100 %









Aufgaben




Deine Aufgaben





Entscheide aus Daten: Attribution, Inkrementalitäts- und Geo-Tests (z. B. für Plakat und TV) und eine verbindliche ROAS-Zahl; du gibst Marketing und Geschäftsleitung eine klare Empfehlung


BI und KPIs: KPI-Definitionen und Dashboards für Marketing, B2B und Geschäftsleitung, die jede Woche genutzt werden


Datenpipeline und Automationen: Shop-, Marketing- und CRM-Daten über n8n und Triple Whale nach BigQuery betreiben, vereinfachen und weiterentwickeln


CRM: Pipedrive so weiterentwickeln, dass aus deinen Analysen Aktionen werden: Scoring, Segmente und Listen für den Vertrieb und für Klaviyo


Tracking: sicherstellen, dass GA4, Server-Side-Tagging, Meta Conversions API und Consent stimmen; die Umsetzung übernimmt unser Shop-Team


Agenturen und Tools: fachliche Empfehlung zu Kosten und Wirkung von Meta, Amazon, Affiliates und TV


Praktikum: fachliche Betreuung unseres Praktikums Data & KI-Automation









Deine ersten 90 Tage





Es gibt eine verbindliche Zahl für den Meta-ROAS und deine Empfehlung zum Budget


Ein erster Geo-Test für Plakat oder TV ist aufgesetzt


Die Pipeline ist dokumentiert, und das Team nutzt die wichtigsten Dashboards jede Woche









Qualifikation




Was du mitbringst





Du leitest aus Zahlen eine klare Empfehlung ab und vertrittst sie gegenüber der Geschäftsleitung


Du hast Tests oder Attributionsanalysen selbst aufgesetzt und weisst, wo ihre Grenzen liegen


Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Digital Business, Informatik oder Wirtschaft mit quantitativem Schwerpunkt


2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung, z. B. in einer Digital- oder Analytics-Beratung, einer Agentur oder einem Scale-up (Marketing Analytics, RevOps, Growth)


Du baust selbst: sicheres SQL, Automationen mit n8n, Make oder Code, APIs und Webhooks. KI-Werkzeuge wie Claude nutzt du im Alltag.


Du hast mit einem CRM gearbeitet und seine Daten genutzt, idealerweise Pipedrive, HubSpot oder Salesforce


Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau, gutes Englisch; Französisch ist ein Plus


Ein Plus: Erfahrung im E-Commerce oder D2C, Python









Benefits




Was wir bieten





Eigener Stack: Du verantwortest Daten und Tools von Anfang bis Ende, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsleitung


KI im Alltag: Ein Team, das mit Claude und Automationen arbeitet und dir Raum gibt, Neues auszuprobieren


Rahmen: Kompetitives Gehalt, bis zu 28 Ferientage, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Unterstützung für dein Home-Office-Setup


Perspektive: Langfristig in einem wachsenden Unternehmen, mit Themen, die mit dir mitwachsen









Bewerbung




Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein Beispiel für einen Entscheid, den du aus Daten abgeleitet hast: die Frage, dein Vorgehen und was danach passiert ist. Ein paar Sätze und ein Screenshot reichen. Im Prozess lernst du Jonas und Christian kennen und löst einen kurzen Case mit echten, anonymisierten Daten.

Today, we continue to focus on caring for customers, employees and the environment.

Strategic Analysis and Benchmarking of MSC Trade Revenues (Sea and Land)




Lead the comprehensive analysis of MSC trade revenues across sea and land identifying key trends, market conditions, and performance indicators.

Join us and celebrate the beauty of human experience. Create for happier, healthier lives, with love for nature. Together, with passion and creativity, we deliver food innovations, craft inspired fragrances and develop beauty and wellbeing solutions. There’s much to learn and many to learn from, with more than 17,000 employees around the world to explore ideas and ambitions with. Every day, your talent, your innovative spirit, and your determination will shape our future, making a positive difference on billions of people. Every essence of you enriches our world. We are Givaudan. Human by nature.

As a Senior Regulatory Data Analyst (w/m/d), you will report to the Registration & Compliance Lead. The lead is part of the Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE. You will work within our Regulatory Ingredients Compliance Strategy CoE, specifically in the Registration & Compliance department. This department is located at our Vernier site in Switzerland.

You will provide subject matter expertise with chemical regulatory compliance, chemical management and carry out compliance monitoring reviews to ensure the business is meeting its regulatory obligations and risks are avoided.

You will develop, implement and maintain processes, programs to ensure compliance with all chemical control legislations.

In This Exciting Role You Will

  • Perform compliance monitoring on CCL (Chemical Control Legislation) to assess compliance with applicable regulations, standards and outcomes;
  • Collaborate with the RAPS team and business stakeholders to finalise reports for presentation and submission to relevant boards and sub-committees, following the requirements of the plan, including impact analysis for decision making;
  • Provide analyses for large datasets necessary for decisions using relevant insights;
  • Attend sub-committee's sessions to present findings and recommendations;
  • Support the review/update/development of the regulatory/compliance policies and procedures to ensure they remain appropriate, relevant and effective;
  • Participate to the development of the solutions to ensure of the compliance globally, the testing and the training of the teams;
  • Define and deliver metrics, reporting platforms, dashboards for tracking and managing compliance;
  • Track monitoring actions to successful resolution;
  • Identify business challenges and initiate process improvement projects;
  • Facilitate the computerization of analytics and data collection processes.

Your Professional Profile Includes

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a scientific field;
  • A minimum of 5 years relevant in a compliance role in chemical or related industry;
  • Proficient knowledge of BI, SAP, or other business Intelligence tools; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint;
  • Familiarity with programming languages (e.g: Python, Javascript, SQL) and AI is beneificial;
  • Strong analytical skills;
  • Knowledge of CCL regulatory requirements and legal guidelines is beneficial;
  • Business fluency in English and French is a must;
  • Experience supporting cross functional groups and teams

Our Benefits

  • Healthcare support
  • Paid Time Off and family leave
  • Retirement plan
  • Sport and leisure clubs
  • Company shop
  • Staff restaurant
  • Corporate Mobility Plan

We value the different perspectives that come from diverse cultures, backgrounds, and experiences.

Everyone — regardless of race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, culture, religion, or any personal circumstances — is warmly welcomed at Givaudan, a place where we all love to be and grow.

Every essence of you enriches our world. Join us in making a difference together.

Title: Senior Analyst Services Analytics EU & WWI

Company Description

At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. For more than 25 years, we have worked with hospitals and care teams around the world to help solve some of healthcare’s hardest challenges and advance what is possible.

Intuitive has been built by the efforts of great people from diverse backgrounds. We believe great ideas can come from anywhere—we strive to foster an inclusive culture built around diversity of thought and mutual respect. We lead with inclusion and empower our team members to do their best work as their most authentic selves.

Passionate people who want to make a difference drive our culture—our team members are grounded in integrity, have a strong capacity to learn, the energy to get things done, and bring diverse, real-world experiences to help us think in new ways. We actively invest in our team members to support their long-term growth so they can continue to advance our mission and achieve their highest potential.

Join a team committed to taking big leaps forward for a global community of healthcare professionals and their patients. Together, let’s advance the world of minimally invasive care.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position:

The Senior Service Analytics Analyst – EU & WWI serves as a strategic analytics and finance partner to the EU & WWI Customer Experience & Services leadership team. The role integrates financial, operational, customer, and workforce data to generate forward-looking insights, evaluate business scenarios, and influence decisions that improve Services performance, scalability, and profitability.

Supporting Field Services, Technical Support, Digital Technical Support, Customer Services, and Customer Success, this role goes beyond reporting to identify key business drivers, quantify opportunities and tradeoffs, and translate complex analyses into clear, actionable recommendations.

The Senior Analyst will also leverage AI, automation, and advanced analytics to accelerate insight generation, strengthen forecasting and scenario modeling, and enable more effective, scalable decision support.

Roles And Responsibilities


Deliver integrated financial and operational analytics that identify performance drivers, risks, and opportunities across EU & WWI Services.
Develop scenario, sensitivity, and driver-based models to evaluate strategic alternatives, quantify tradeoffs, and support business decisions.
Provide insights and recommendations across revenue, cost-to-serve, margin, profitability, productivity, workforce capacity, and customer performance.
Support financial planning and performance management, including forecasting, budgeting, P&L analysis, variance analysis, and identification of risks and opportunities.
Translate complex business questions into structured analyses and forward-looking recommendations that enable leadership action.
Support regional Objectives, Goals, Strategies & Tactics (OGST) by connecting financial and operational KPIs to business outcomes and strategic priorities.
Apply AI, automation, and advanced analytics to identify patterns and anomalies, accelerate recurring analysis, improve forecasting, and generate deeper insights.
Partner across Services, Operations, IT, Data & Analytics, and global teams to strengthen data quality, metric consistency, and analytical capabilities.
Communicate complex analysis through concise, executive-ready insights, scenarios, and recommendations that clearly articulate business implications and expected impact.
Drive continuous improvement by simplifying, automating, and scaling analytical processes and best practices across EU & WWI.


Qualifications

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience:Fina


Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of relevant experience in financial analytics, business analytics, FP&A, operational finance, data analytics, or a related field.
Strong financial acumen, including P&L, forecasting, budgeting, variance analysis, cost drivers, margin, profitability, and financial modeling.
Demonstrated ability to integrate financial and operational data and translate analysis into business insights and recommendations.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure and solve complex, ambiguous business problems.
Experience with analytics and BI tools such as Tableau, SQL, Snowflake, or similar platforms, along with advanced Excel skills.
Practical experience or strong interest in applying AI and automation to finance and analytics workflows.
Strong business acumen and understanding of the relationship between operational, customer, workforce, and financial performance.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with demonstrated ability to influence business and finance stakeholders.
Proactive and intellectually curious, with the ability to identify insights and opportunities beyond the initial analytical request.
Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, cultures, and geographies.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


Additional Information

Intuitive is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

Title: Retail Business Analytics Manager
Description:
Where passion meets opportunity

The best of your adventures is the one you have yet to sail!

Your Purpose

The Retail Business Analytics Manager is responsible for transforming retail data into actionable business insights that improve commercial performance, inventory productivity and decision-making across MSC Cruises and Explora Journeys.

The role provides analytical leadership across sales performance, profitability, demand planning, inventory optimization and commercial governance.

Working closely with Retail Leadership, Category Managers, Planning teams, Finance, Operations and Digital teams, the role develops the analytical frameworks, dashboards and insights required to optimize assortment, inventory investment and retail performance across the global fleet.

The position acts as a strategic business partner, enabling data-driven decisions and continuous improvement across all retail categories

Your Impact

Business Performance Analytics


Develop and maintain retail performance dashboards covering sales, margin, inventory and productivity indicators.
Provide regular performance analysis by:
Ship
Boutique
Category
Brand
SK
Itinerary
Guest segment
Identify commercial opportunities and performance gaps.
Translate data into clear recommendations and action plans for Retail Leadership and Category teams.


KPI Framework & Reporting


Define and improve the global retail KPI framework, including:
Sales performance
Conversion rate
Average Transaction Value (ATV)
Units Per Transaction (UPT)
Sales per square meter / selling space
Sell-through
Gross margin
Inventory productivity
Stock turn
Create automated reporting tools to improve decision speed and visibility.
Support weekly, monthly and seasonal business reviews.


Demand & Inventory Analytics


Support demand forecasting by SKU, ship, boutique and geographic area.
Analyze sales trends, seasonality, itinerary impact and guest behavior to improve forecasts.
Identify best sellers, slow movers and inventory risks.
Provide recommendations for:
Allocation
Replenishment
Stock balancing
Inventory optimization
Support stock shortage prevention and opportunity capture.


Commercial Control & Profitability


Monitor margin performance and identify improvement opportunities.
Support pricing validation and pricing consistency across categories.
Analyze promotional performance and markdown effectiveness.
Support annual budgeting, forecasting and Open-To-Buy (OTB) governance.
Evaluate profitability by:
Category
Brand
Product
Ship
Boutique


Assortment & Category Insights


Provide analytical support to Category Managers for assortment decisions.
Analyze:
Product productivity
SKU contribution
Collection performance
Brand performance
Price architecture
Identify opportunities to improve assortment depth and efficiency.
Support seasonal assortment reviews and buying decisions.


Inventory Productivity


Monitor inventory health across the fleet.
Identify:
Overstock situations
Stock shortages
Obsolete inventory
Low productivity products
Recommend actions to improve inventory return and cash efficiency.
Support markdown and liquidation decisions when required.


Data Management & Tools


Partner with IT and Digital teams to improve retail data availability and reporting capabilities.
Support the development of future retail systems and analytics solutions.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency and governance.
Contribute to the transition from manual Excel-based reporting toward automated analytics.


Cross Functional Collaboration


Work closely with:
Head of Forecast, Budget and Analytics
Category Managers
Retail Operations
Merchandise Planning
Finance
Supply Chain
IT / Digital teams
Act as a trusted analytical partner supporting commercial decisions


Your Journey so far


5–10 years of experience in retail analytics, merchandise planning, business intelligence or commercial performance.
Experience in luxury retail, fashion, travel retail or multi-store environments.
Strong experience analyzing sales, inventory and profitability data.
Experience building dashboards and performance reporting frameworks.
Experience with retail planning systems, BI tools and advanced Excel.


Your Essentials


Strong analytical and quantitative skills.
Excellent understanding of retail business drivers and commercial KPIs.
Ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Strong understanding of inventory management and merchandise planning principles.
Advanced Excel skills and experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or equivalent).
Strong communication skills and ability to influence stakeholders.
Business-oriented mindset with attention to operational details.
Ability to work in a fast-moving international environment.
Fluent English; additional languages are an advantage.


Our commitment

We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

You will design and develop new data products for our service business, with a particular focus on company-wide reporting. In the future, you will also support organizational development through the introduction and application of process mining tools for process analysis and optimization.

In addition, you will be responsible for further data-related development initiatives and provide valuable insights through your analyses to support strategic decision-making. Your work will strengthen a data-driven culture and enable data-powered services, giving you a direct impact on the success of the entire organization.



Design and develop data models based on SAP Datasphere
Create analytical dashboards and reports with defined KPIs in SAP Analytics Cloud and identify optimization opportunities based on the results
Implement, document, and roll out developed data models
Lead data-driven projects and initiatives as a Project Manager or Program Manager
Build and implement a Process Mining solution to enable root cause analyses

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Data Science, or a related field
Strong passion for data, analytics, and business processes, combined with excellent conceptual thinking skills

Solid knowledge of data analysis methods and models
Confident working with large datasets and experienced in using databases and data visualization tools
Proficient to advanced knowledge of SQL and practical experience with SAP; knowledge of Python is an advantage
Excellent communication skills with the ability to present findings clearly, persuasively, and in a stakeholder-oriented manner

Thrive in an international, collaborative and fun work environment
