Title: Healthcare Business Consultant - Financial & Governance Analytics
Description:
Chi Siamo




BI Health, parte di Maps Group, è il partner strategico che guida le Istituzioni e le Organizzazioni Sanitarie verso una governance data-driven.

Grazie a una consolidata esperienza nella consulenza di direzione e attraverso l’utilizzo di soluzioni d’avanguardia di Business Intelligence e Advanced Data Analytics verticalizzate sul mondo Healthcare, la nostra mission è trasformare i dati clinici e operativi in informazioni strategiche, permettendo al management sanitario di misurare le performance dell'offerta assistenziale, e ottimizzare ogni processo decisionale.

Entrare a far parte del nostro team significa contribuire attivamente all'innovazione e all'efficienza della sanità del futuro.




Ruolo e Scopo della Posizione




In qualità di Business Consultant, sarai il punto di riferimento strategico per le Direzioni Sanitarie dei nostri clienti. Il tuo obiettivo principale sarà supportare il management medico e amministrativo nel prendere decisioni strategiche e operative consapevoli. Analizzerai il patrimonio informativo delle strutture, identificherai i KPI più rilevanti e realizzerai dashboard di monitoraggio capaci di guidare la governance sanitaria e l'efficientamento dei processi.




Principali Responsabilità




Consulenza Strategica: Affiancare le Direzioni Sanitarie nell'analisi dei dati gestionali e clinici, traducendo la complessità informativa in chiarezza strategica.
KPI & Performance Management: Identificare, definire e mettere in luce gli indicatori chiave di prestazione (KPI) clinici, economici e operativi dell'offerta assistenziale.
Business Intelligence: Progettare e sviluppare dashboard analitiche e reportistica avanzata per abilitare un monitoraggio agile e puntuale.
Controllo di Gestione: Applicare logiche di contabilità analitica e controllo di gestione specifiche per il settore sanitario (es. costi per centro di costo, DRG, efficienza dei reparti).




Requisiti Richiesti




Esperienza e Settore: Almeno 4 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di consulente direzionale, di processo o di controllo di gestione all'interno del mondo dell'economia sanitaria e del settore Healthcare.
Competenze Finanziarie/Analitiche: Solida conoscenza della contabilità analitica applicata alle organizzazioni sanitarie.
Competenze Tecniche: Conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence, con particolare focus su QlikView (la conoscenza di altri strumenti di Data Visualization costituisce un plus).
Project Management: Capacità di gestione dei progetti, dall'analisi dei requisiti (scoping) fino alla consegna finale, coordinando i diversi stakeholder interni ed esterni.
Soft Skills: Forti capacità analitiche e di problem solving, eccellenti doti relazionali e di comunicazione, capacità di interfacciarsi con il C-level/Direzioni Sanitarie, attitudine al lavoro per obiettivi.




La sede di riferimento sarà: Roma




Cosa ti offriamo

Contratto di Assunzione;
Buoni pasto e benefit di welfare aziendali;
PC e telefono aziendali;
Un ambiente meritocratico che premia lo spirito di iniziativa;




Retribuzione offerta: tra 35.000€ e 40.000€ lordi annui (RAL)

Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche e all'esperienza pregressa maturate nel ruolo.




Mandaci il tuo CV dettagliato, specificando l’autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali contenuti nel Curriculum Vitae ai sensi del D. Lgs. 196/2003 e all’art. 13 GDPR (Regolamento UE 2016/679) ai fini della ricerca e selezione del personale.

I dati richiesti verranno trattati esclusivamente ai fini di selezione.

L’annuncio è rivolto a candidati di ambo i sessi.




La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l’impegno di sostenere l’inclusività e la diversity

Title: Junior Data Engineer
HTML:
We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Vuoi fare un lavoro che sia davvero significativo e di impatto? In KPMG avrai l’opportunità di aiutare i clienti, la società, le colleghe e i colleghi ad affrontare e risolvere le sfide più attuali e complesse. KPMG Advisory offre servizi di consulenza alle imprese per affiancarle nella trasformazione del business model, nel miglioramento e nella digitalizzazione dei processi, nell'analisi e nella gestione dei rischi, nonché supporto nelle operazioni di finanza straordinaria.

Nel particolare, entrerai a far parte del Team di Lighthouse di Roma.

La Lighthouse è il centro di eccellenza di KPMG Advisory che offre soluzioni di Data & Analytics sul mercato.

Unendoti al team, svilupperai soluzioni innovative attingendo dalle nostre competenze globali. Combinerai informatica, matematica, statistica e business per creare analisi predittive, presentandole e comunicandole con professionalità e competenza. Opererai in un ambiente orientato all'innovazione tecnologica, occupandoti dell'ingegneria dei dati, con un forte focus sulla progettazione delle informazioni e visualizzazione dei dati. Abbiamo ricevuto riconoscimenti internazionali per quanto riguarda la nostra capacità di interpretare e gestire i dati.

Nello specifico, ti occuperai di:

  • Analisi di modelli analitici a supporto dei processi di business;
  • Analisi, progettazione e implementazione di fonti di dati;
  • Data Visualization, Advanced Analytics, Big Data;
  • Progettare KPI e i framework di calcolo più efficienti;
  • Analizzare, progettare e implementare modelli di reporting e dashboard di monitoraggio;
  • Analizzare processi aziendali e progettare modelli di supporto analitico;
  • Implementare soluzioni analitiche, supportare il go-live e gestire la manutenzione delle applicazioni.

Come As You Are - Le tue competenze e caratteristiche

Questa opportunità è perfetta per te se:

  • Possiedi una Laurea in economia, matematica, ingegneria matematica, statistica, ingegneria informatica, ingegneria gestionale o informatica;
  • Hai sviluppato conoscenza in ambito dati e database (modelli dati entità/relazioni, DBMS)
  • Hai sviluppato la capacità di combinare competenze aziendali con competenze IT, inclusa la modellazione dei dati;
  • Hai sviluppato interesse per la Data Visualization e Business Intelligence
  • Hai sviluppato Interesse per i tool ed i processi ETL (Informatica, Talend, Datastage);
  • Hai una buona padronanza della lingua inglese, preferibilmente con esperienze di studio e/o lavoro all'estero;
  • Possiedi conoscenza di almeno uno dei seguenti database (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e hai sviluppato competenze in SQL; la conoscenza di linguaggi di programmazione rappresenta un vantaggio.

Your Future With Us - Cosa troverai in KPMG

  • Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, equo e che rispetta, incoraggia e valorizza le diversità;
  • Un contesto stimolante e dinamico che incentiva la creatività e il lavoro di squadra;
  • Modalità di lavoro ibrida, per promuovere un sano equilibrio tra vita lavorativa e personale;
  • Programmi di formazione e sviluppo avanzati per rimanere sempre aggiornati;
  • Mindset internazionale e progettualità innovative;
  • Iniziative incentrate sul benessere psicofisico.

L’opportunità prevede un inserimento con indennità mensile di 800€ per stage curriculare o 1.000€ per stage extracurriculare o in assunzione con inquadramento ai sensi del CCNL Commercio e RAL di ingresso: € 30.000, determinata sulla base di criteri oggettivi quali il titolo di studio e la valutazione del profilo rispetto ai requisiti della posizione.

In ottemperanza alla normativa vigente, non raccogliamo né utilizziamo informazioni sulle retribuzioni percepite in rapporti di lavoro attuali o precedenti. Le nostre procedure di selezione sono, inoltre, improntate a criteri oggettivi e neutrali rispetto al genere.

Together for Better – I nostri valori e il nostro impegno

Leadership, lavoro in team, rispetto di ogni individualità, approfondimento continuo, trasparenza, impegno verso la comunità, integrità: questi sono i Valori di KPMG che danno vita a un ambiente aperto allo scambio di idee e di conoscenza, che permette ai nostri professionisti di esprimere tutto il loro potenziale.

GGrazie all’impegno nel favorire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, il nostro Network risulta conforme agli standard dei requisiti ISO 30415, sul Sistema di Gestione per la Diversità e l’Inclusione, e UNI PdR 125, relativa alla parità di genere. All’interno del nostro Impact Plan - Our Impact Plan (kpmg.com) - trovi riassunte tutte le azioni che stiamo portando avanti su tematiche ambientali, sociali e di governance (ESG).

Unisciti a noi!

I tuoi dati saranno trattati nel pieno rispetto delle disposizioni del Regolamento (UE) n. 679/2016 (General Data Protection Regulation - "GDPR") e successive modifiche. Per ulteriori informazioni, consultare l'informativa sulla privacy di KPMG.

KPMG Advisory S.p.A. garantisce le pari opportunità

At KPMG - no secrets with big data

We let the future guide us. Join our next generation

Title: Statistician
Description:
Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis, in the food and agriculture statistics domains. In these statistical domains, it also plays a key role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data, and provides essential capacity building in support of member countries. The Division also disseminates publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks, that cover agriculture and food security statistics, including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data. Finally, as the ESS Director also plays the role of FAO Chief Statistician, the Division supports the various functions of the Chief Statistician, that is to ensure stronger governance of FAO's data and statistical system, foster consistency of FAO's Data and Statistical programme within the Strategic Framework, ensure statistical excellence through the implementation of statistical standards and quality assurance mechanisms, and position FAO's presence in data and statistical discussions at global level.

The incumbent will work in the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics team within the Statistics Division and will contribute to the production and dissemination of all statistics reported in the Food Security and Nutrition, Food and Diet, and Cost and Affordability of Healthy Diets data domains of FAOSTAT.

The position is located in the Statistics Division (ESS) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician reports to the Senior Statistician and team leader of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team, under the overall guidance of the Director of ESS.

Technical Focus

The S tatistician will provide statistical expertise in the improvement of existing methods and development of new methods for the generation of food security and nutrition statistics, and in the compilation, processing, validation, analysis, storage and dissemination of data, microdata and metadata, with a special emphasis on data from experience-based food security scales. The role includes: ensuring the correct application of methods to estimate the Prevalence of food insecurity based on Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES), the Prevalence of Undernourishment (PoU), and the Prevalence of Unaffordability of a healthy diet (PUA); the production of high quality documents and statistical tools, including software packages, scripts, datasets and reports on the analysis of food security and nutrition data; collaborating with external stakeholders and partners, including national statistical offices and other international organizations or research institutions, involved in the collection, analysis, dissemination and reporting of food security and nutrition statistics based on FAO endorsed statistical methods and definitions.

Key Results

Research and analysis of information, data and statistics, statistical methods, statistical and econometric modelling. Development and maintenance of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases and the technical assistance services to support the implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions


Collects, reviews, processes and/or analyses key social/economic/environmental/indicators, based on both traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods, to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work, which can be focused on products, projects, publications or services.
Develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems, databases.
Conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
Produces a variety of technical reports and provides input in technical documents, divisional publications and/or web pages.
Provides response to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices, including technical backstopping to field projects.
Participates in multidisciplinary teams, collaborates with other Divisions/Offices/Centres on work groups and committees and promotes best practices.
Provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
Participates in divisional teams, Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
Supports the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with the Strategic Framework and divisional plans.
Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.


Specific Functions

Maintains and refines the methodology and the statistical tools to compute the Prevalence of Food Insecurity based on FIES and other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the FSN statistics Team.


Contributes to the development of analytic models and scoring strategies for the FIES, with the aim of ensuring cross-country comparability and stability over time of the food security measure.
Analyses results to identify potential inconsistencies in the level s and trends of different indicators (FIES-based, PoU, PUA, economic and social well-being) and propose s appropriate strateg ies to address them.
Maintains and extends the analytic codes and statistical methods to analyse FIES data through Item Response Theory models (both dichotomous and polytomous) as needed for various purposes (capacity building, research, SDG monitoring, IPC classification etc.).
R eviews sampling frames of surveys used to inform food insecurity indicators, including post-stratification weighting, with the purpose of assessing the survey quality and re-adjusts the sampling weights if needed.
Provides methodological guidance for the improvement of other food security and nutrition indicators produced by the team, including the PoU and PUA.
Works on and refines the methodologies for data disaggregation and variance computation of the different food security and nutrition indicators.


Undertakes and supports data analysis and dissemination activities.


Conducts analyses of national datasets collected in order to determine the potential for producing food insecurity prevalence estimates to inform the global assessment.
Contributes to the publication of divisional reports and scientific papers on the FIES methodology and empirical application.
Conduct s research on extending existing methods to different applications (e.g. acute food insecurity monitoring, right to food, urban food security, etc.).
Contributes to discussions among food security analysts in different fora, providing guidance for the analysis and interpretation of food security indicators.
Disseminates and interprets results based on the analysis of FIES data in different platforms and systems (Statistical Working System -SWS, FAOSTAT, UNSD, etc.).
Drafts sections of the State of Food Insecurity and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) report that concern statistical data analysis and interpretation of the food security indicators, updating and interpreting the latest trends and contributing in the thematic part as needed.
Supports the computation of regional aggregates of various food security and nutrition indicators to be disseminated in FAOSTAT and other data platforms.


Provide technical assistance and capacity development on the FIES-based and other food security indicators.


Within the mandate of the Food Security and Nutrition Statistics Team , provides assistance for statistical analyses related to food security indicators to other teams and divisions in FAO, to professionals from other international agencies, NGOs and academicians with an interest towards food security measurement, their interpretation and use in policy making.
Provides technical assistance to national statistical offices for statistical analyses of food security data collected in national surveys.
Designs, tests and conducts capacity development activities on the use of the developed FAO software and modelling approach to assess access to food (may require travel and language courses).
Oversees the development of web-based learning materials for the software and model application to estimate the access to food, both for internal (FAO) and external (not FAO) users.


Provide statistical expertise/support to other members of the food security and nutrition statistics team as necessary.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements


Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in statistics, mathematics, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field.
Five years of relevant experience in the compilation and analysis of food and agricultural statistics in national or international organizations with focus on the methodological development and production of food security statistics.
Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).


Competencies


Results Focus
Teamwork
Communication
Building Effective Relationships
Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


Technical/Functional Skills


Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field positions.
Strong command of statistical methods including: data presentation, analysis and descriptive statistics; main continuous and discrete random variables (binomial, normal, standard normal, log-normal) and their properties; probability distributions; conditional probability, probabilities of intersections of events, Bayes' theorem; correlation and rank correlation; sampling and sample size: simple, stratified, and multistage random sampling; Inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and significance; linear regression (single and multiple) comparison of population means and variances, ANOVA; Chi-square and goodness of fit tests; nonlinear models: maximum likelihood estimation; elements of survey and questionnaire design.
Extent and relevance of experience and knowledge of the main data sources used for the compilation of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in the compilation, validation, and analysis of food security statistics.
Extent and relevance of experience in software used for processing and analysing data, such as R, STATA, SPSS, SAS.
Extent and relevance of statistical programming skills.
Depth familiarity with relevant statistical methods for data analysis using Item Response Theory.
Ability to analyse complex statistical-related issues.

The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to MORE efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production , better nutrition , a better environment , and a better life , leaving no one behind.

FAO's commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations.

Organizational Setting

The Statistics Division (ESS) develops and advocates for the implementation of methodologies and standards for data collection, validation, processing and analysis of food and agriculture statistics. In these statistical domains, it also plays a vital role in the compilation, processing and dissemination of internationally comparable data and provides essential capacity building support to Member Nations. In addition, the Division disseminates many publications, working papers and statistical yearbooks that cover agricultural and food security relevant statistics (including prices, investments, production, trade and agri-environmental statistical data).

The incumbent will work for the Agricultural Census Team, that is responsible for developing the methodological guidelines for the FAO World Programme for the Census of Agriculture (WCA), as well as conducting agricultural surveys to document country practices. The team is also responsible for assisting countries in strengthening their national agricultural statistical systems by providing technical assistance to carry out national agricultural census at least once every decade and to run a continuous programme of agricultural surveys, using standard international concepts, definitions and methodologies.

The position is located in the Statistics Division ( ESS ) at FAO headquarters in Rome, Italy.

Reporting Lines

The Statistician (Statistics) reports to the Senior Statistician/Leader of the Agricultural Censuses Team under the overall guidance of the Director, ESS.

Technical Focus

Agricultural Censuses and surveys.

Key Results

Comprehensive technical, statistical, analytical and/or policy analysis services and the development of specialized tools, methodologies, systems and/or databases to support the planning, implementation/delivery and monitoring of the programme of work and related products, projects, publications and services.

Key Functions

  • Plans and leads components of multidisciplinary teams and short-term work groups, leads and/or participates in Divisional teams, participates in Organization-wide committees, project teams and working groups and provides specialized expertise on international technical networks and or technical policy and standard setting bodies.
  • Coordinates the collection, review, processing and/or analysis of key social/economic/environmental indicators, based on either traditional statistical methods/sources or on unstructured sources and data science methods to support the delivery of economic and social development programmes of work whether focused on products, projects, publications or services.
  • Designs and develops improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, systems and databases.
  • Designs and conducts research, data collection, validation, analysis and/or reporting in support of the development of technical standards, international instruments, innovative tools and methodologies to be used within the Organization or by external stakeholders.
  • Coordinates the production of a variety of technical reports and provides input in flagship publications, technical documents, Divisional publications and/or web pages.
  • Coordinates and provides responses to requests and provides technical and/or policy advice, assistance and solutions to Regional, Subregional and Country Offices including technical backstopping of field projects.
  • Coordinates and provides capacity development services, including the planning and organization of training workshops and seminars and the preparation of related information, materials, on-line tools and information kits.
  • Coordinates the organization, conduct and follow-up of meetings, consultations and conferences, the development/production of required materials and the provision of information and assistance to partners.
  • Participates in resource mobilization activities in accordance with Strategic Framework and Divisional plans.
  • Promotes international cooperation and collaboration, advocates best practices, knowledge sharing, increased policy dialogue, and provides technical expertise at international meetings and conferences.

Specific Functions

  • Identifies and formulates food and agricultural statistics development projects and assists with their implementation, monitoring and evaluation.
  • Contributes to support the World Programme for the Census of Agriculture (WCA) and FAO's Agricultural Survey programme.
  • Develops and updates conceptual, methodological and operational guidelines to collect statistical information on the agricultural sector at national level through agriculture censuses and agricultural surveys.
  • Coordinates and implements technical support to FAO units and member countries in the design, planning, and implementation of agricultural censuses and surveys, including formulation of country projects, the design of questionnaires and manuals, the implementation of cognitive and pilot testing, sample design, training of field staff, the use of advanced data collection technologies, and the dissemination of census and survey data and microdata.
  • Coordinates the preparation and delivery of training and dissemination materials on agricultural censuses and surveys to country officials and field staff.
  • Provides hands-on support to national institutions in applying statistical methods to large farm datasets, including editing, validation and analysis of the data with statistical software.
  • Coordinates and supports the monitoring and documentation of countries' censuses, prepares metadata reviews and main census results.
  • Coordinates and implements the processing and dissemination of census data from WCA rounds to the FAOSTAT (FAO database) domain.
  • Coordinates and supports the preparation of technical articles, working papers, books and training materials and documents best practices in agricultural censuses and surveys.
  • Supports the mobilization of extra-budgetary resources in support of the implementation of agricultural censuses and surveys.
  • Performs other duties as required.

CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING

Minimum Requirements

  • Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in statistics, mathematics, economics, or a related field.
  • Seven years of relevant experience in the compilation and analysis of food and agricultural statistics in national or international organizations and in the coordination of high-level statistical publications and management of statistical dissemination platform.
  • Working knowledge (proficiency - level C) of English and intermediate knowledge (intermediate proficiency - level B) of another FAO official language (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian or Spanish).

Competencies

  • Results Focus
  • Teamwork
  • Communication
  • Building Effective Relationships
  • Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement

Technical/Functional Skills

  • Work experience in more than one location or area of work, particularly in field positions.
  • Strong command of statistical methods including: data presentation, analysis and descriptive statistics; main continuous and discrete random variables (binomial, normal, standard normal, log-normal) and their properties; probability distributions; conditional probability, probabilities of intersections of events, Bayes' theorem; correlation and rank correlation; sampling and sample size: simple, stratified, and multistage random sampling; Inference, confidence intervals, hypothesis testing and significance; linear regression (single and multiple) comparison of population means and variances, ANOVA; Chi-square and goodness of fit tests; nonlinear models: maximum likelihood estimation; elements of survey and questionnaire design.
  • Extent and relevance of knowledge and experience in collecting, compiling and disseminating agricultural statistics .
  • Extent and relevance of experience in the formulation of technical assistance projects as well as the planning and the provision of capacity development programmes and technical support at the country level for agricultural censuses and surveys.
  • Extent of knowledge and experience in agricultural survey methodology, including survey design, sampling, questionnaire design, data collection and validation methods.
  • Exten t of proficiency and experience in CAPI survey tools and in using software tools for validating, processing and analysing microdata from large-scale agricultural surveys.
  • Extent of experience in microdata dissemination and knowledge of statistical disclosure control methods and tools.
  • Relevant practical experience i n the design and implementation of agricultural census es and surveys methodology, including data validation and dissemination.

Job Description

KeyBiz è una società di consulenza specializzata in trasformazione digitale e servizi IT per clienti enterprise. Operiamo in contesti internazionali strutturati, con un forte focus sull’innovazione e l’eccellenza operativa. La nostra cultura aziendale valorizza la collaborazione, la crescita professionale e l’adozione di tecnologie all’avanguardia per supportare i nostri clienti nel percorso di digitalizzazione.

Descrizione del ruolo

Stiamo cercando un/una Service Operations Analyst – AI & Automation da inserire in un contesto internazionale presso un cliente del settore telecomunicazioni. La risorsa supporterà il team di Service Manager nelle attività operative, di reporting e analisi delle performance dei servizi digitali, contribuendo allo sviluppo di automazioni basate su AI e GenAI.

Responsabilità principali

  • Produzione e manutenzione di report periodici su SLA, OLA, KPI di servizio, trend e backlog con focus sul miglioramento continuo;
  • Analisi dati operativi, supporto alla qualità dei dati e sviluppo di metriche per stakeholder IT e business;
  • Supporto nella gestione dei processi Incident, Problem e Request Fulfillment, monitoraggio code operative e follow-up delle attività aperte;
  • Aggiornamento della knowledge base (FAQ, runbook, playbook) per garantire la condivisione delle informazioni;
  • Prototipazione di automazioni leggere tramite Copilot/GenAI e scripting di base (es. estrazione dati, arricchimento ticket);
  • Contributo all’identificazione e valutazione di nuovi casi d’uso AI in ambito Service Operations;
  • Preparazione di presentazioni operative in italiano e inglese per stakeholder IT e business;
  • Collaborazione quotidiana con team internazionali (Operations, Service Desk, Vendor, Business);
  • Aggiornamento documentazione su SharePoint e ServiceNow garantendo tracciabilità e qualità.

  • Laurea STEM o esperienza pratica equivalente;
  • Eccellente conoscenza della lingua inglese per reportistica, presentazioni e interazioni operative;

  • Proattività, autonomia operativa e attitudine al lavoro in team.

  • Esperienza con strumenti ITSM come ServiceNow (preferibile), Jira, Zendesk o OTRS;
  • Nozioni base di Python o capacità nell’interrogazione di dataset;
  • Esperienza nel settore telecomunicazioni;
  • Competenze nella programmazione e integrazione sistemi.

  • Eccellente comunicazione chiara ed orientamento al cliente;
  • Adeguate capacità di problem solving nonché gestione efficace del tempo e delle priorità;
  • Cura tecnologica costante con attitudine all’apprendimento continuo;

  • Percorsi formativi dedicati su ITIL/ITSM e AI/GenAI;
  • Sperimentazione concreta su automazioni innovative con contributo a iniziative di miglioramento continuo;
  • Sistema welfare aziendale completo;
  • Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa.

L’offerta prevede una RAL compresa tra €35.000 e €40.000 annui .

Modalità di lavoro: Ibrida, due gg a settimana in presenza zona Parco Dè Medici

L’offerta è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi ai sensi della Legge n.903/77. KeyBiz promuove un ambiente lavorativo inclusivo che valorizza diversità culturale ed esperienziale.

I dati personali forniti saranno trattati esclusivamente ai fini della selezione del personale nel rispetto del Regolamento UE 2016/679 (GDPR), secondo principi di liceità, correttezza e trasparenza.

Title: Senior Commercial Insights & Planning Analyst - Contratto a Tempo Determinato
Description:

Stiamo cercando un/una Senior Commercial Insights & Planning Analyst che supporti il processo decisionale del business attraverso analisi commerciali, insight di mercato e pianificazione strutturata.

La persona selezionata entrerà a far parte del team Cluster Insights & Intelligence SE Europe e lavorerà a stretto contatto con Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain e Insights, trasformando dati di mercato e performance commerciali in raccomandazioni concrete per il business italiano.

Il ruolo è ideale per un/una professionista con forte mentalità analitica e orientamento commerciale, interessato/a a comprendere cosa guida la performance del business, quali opportunità emergono dal mercato e quali azioni possono generare valore.

La persona selezionata contribuirà a identificare i principali driver di performance e opportunità di crescita, supportando decisioni commerciali basate su dati e insight.

Responsabilità principali

In questo ruolo contribuirai a trasformare dati e analisi in insight utili a guidare le decisioni commerciali, occupandoti di:


Analisi della performance commerciale, trend di mercato, sell-out, market share e dinamiche competitive per identificare opportunità e aree di miglioramento.
Supporto ai processi di forecasting, scenario modelling e business planning, contribuendo alla definizione di previsioni e scenari futuri.
Monitoraggio delle performance di vendita, categorie e canali, identificando i principali driver di crescita o gli scostamenti rispetto ai piani.
Supporto a business review, IBP/S&OP e valutazione di iniziative commerciali, fornendo analisi e raccomandazioni data-driven.
Traduzione di dati provenienti da diverse fonti in insight chiari e actionable per stakeholder di Sales, Marketing, Finance e Supply Chain.
Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali per supportare decisioni strategiche sul mercato italiano.


Competenze ed esperienze richieste

Il profilo ideale ha una forte mentalità analitica, orientamento commerciale e capacità di trasformare dati e insight in raccomandazioni per il business.

Requisiti:


3+ anni di esperienza in ruoli quali Business Planning, Commercial Insights, Business Performance, Sales Analytics, Market Intelligence, Category Management, Trade Marketing Analytics o ruoli commerciali analitici in contesti FMCG.
Esperienza nell’analisi di performance commerciali, trend di mercato, dati di vendita, category performance o market dynamics.
Capacità di interpretare dati complessi e trasformarli in insight utili al processo decisionale.
Esperienza con forecasting, reporting, business review o pianificazione commerciale.
Ottima conoscenza di Excel e PowerPoint; esperienza con Power BI o strumenti di visualizzazione dati considerata un plus.
Inglese fluente scritto e parlato.
Approccio proattivo, autonomia e capacità di collaborare con stakeholder cross-funzionali.


Costituisce un plus l’esperienza in aziende FMCG, Consumer Goods, Retail o Tobacco.

Offerta prevista

In cambio del tuo ruolo nella costruzione del nostro futuro, riceverai un pacchetto retributivo completo con stipendio, programma di bonus e ulteriori vantaggi, nonché luoghi stimolanti in cui lavorare e collaborare con uno scopo. Qui a Imperial ti daremo l'opportunità di crescere e imparare, innovare al ritmo e far parte del nostro scopo di tracciare un percorso verso un futuro più sano per momenti di relax e piacere per i nostri consumatori.

In Imperial abbiamo il massimo rispetto di ogni dipendente e siamo orgogliosi di essere un'organizzazione realmente inclusiva. Incoraggiamo e accogliamo candidature di persone di tutte le età, sesso, etnia, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o credo e neurodiversità, valutandole con la massima attenzione. Il nostro indirizzo web recruitment@impbrands.com è a disposizione per richieste di assistenza o per definire eventuali colloqui.

Chi siamo

Siamo un'azienda a forte impronta internazionale, la quarta più grande del nostro settore e operante in 119 mercati. Un'azienda produttrice di beni di consumo globale, inclusiva e innovativa che vanta 25.000 dipendenti. Ci stiamo trasformando di pari passo con l'evoluzione del mondo che ci circonda. La nostra visione e cultura del lavoro sono sostenute da una mentalità rivolta al futuro, che pone costantemente in discussione lo status quo e consente alle persone di raggiungere il loro massimo potenziale. La nostra agilità e capacità di collaborazione agevolano il raggiungimento dei nostri obiettivi, l'innovazione e il successo, grazie ai nostri pluripremiati programmi di sviluppo che creano opportunità di carriera estremamente gratificanti.  Incoraggiando l'inclusività a livello locale e sostenendo globalmente un eccezionale programma di diversità, siamo pienamente impegnati a creare e mantenere un ambiente che celebra e rispetta ogni differenza.

Title: Senior Revenue Manager
Description:
🚀 Chi è Sibylla

Sibylla è un'azienda giovane, certificata UNI CEI EN ISO 9001 e UNI CEI EN ISO/IEC 27001, che crede che lavorare non debba essere un obbligo, ma un piacere. Investiamo nella crescita professionale delle nostre persone, promuovendo formazione continua, innovazione e collaborazione.

Nata nel 2020, Sibylla è oggi una realtà in forte espansione nei settori dell'informatica e dell'hotellerie, con partner prestigiosi a livello nazionale e internazionale. Sviluppiamo tecnologie innovative e soluzioni avanzate per la gestione alberghiera, il Revenue Management e la distribuzione, supportando i nostri clienti nel raggiungimento dei migliori risultati di business.




💻 Di cosa ti occuperai

Entrerai a far parte del nostro team Revenue e avrai un ruolo centrale nella gestione e nell'ottimizzazione delle performance delle strutture ricettive seguite da Sibylla.

Le tue principali attività saranno:

Analizzare costantemente i dati di occupazione, domanda e performance delle strutture.
Definire e implementare strategie di pricing dinamico e Revenue Management.
Elaborare forecast di occupazione e ricavi.
Monitorare il mercato, la concorrenza e gli eventi che influenzano la domanda.
Collaborare con il team commerciale per sviluppare strategie di vendita e promozione.
Affiancare i clienti nell'implementazione delle strategie di Revenue Management.
Predisporre report periodici, analisi e KPI a supporto delle decisioni strategiche.
Utilizzare strumenti di Business Intelligence, PMS, RMS e Channel Manager.




🔍 Requisiti

Cerchiamo una persona con:

Esperienza di almeno 2 anni nel ruolo di Revenue Manager o Revenue Analyst nel settore alberghiero.
Laurea in Economia, Turismo o discipline affini (titolo preferenziale).
Ottima conoscenza delle logiche di Revenue Management alberghiero.
Conoscenza dei principali PMS, RMS, Channel Manager e OTA.
Ottima capacità di analisi dei dati e utilizzo avanzato di Microsoft Excel.
Buona conoscenza del pacchetto Microsoft 365 e Microsoft Teams.
Spiccate capacità organizzative, analitiche e orientamento al risultato.
Attitudine al lavoro in team e alla relazione con il cliente.

Costituirà titolo preferenziale la conoscenza di Power BI e dei principali strumenti di Business Intelligence.




✨ Cosa offriamo

Contratto a tempo indeterminato.
Retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza e alle competenze.
Piano di crescita professionale e formazione continua.
Ambiente giovane, dinamico e orientato all'innovazione.
Possibilità di lavorare su progetti ad alto impatto nel settore hospitality.
Collaborazione con un team multidisciplinare composto da professionisti dell'informatica, del turismo e dell'innovazione.
Percorsi di aggiornamento continuo sulle nuove tecnologie e sulle strategie di Revenue Management.




In Sibylla crediamo nel talento, nelle idee e nella crescita delle persone. Se vuoi contribuire all'evoluzione del settore hospitality attraverso innovazione e tecnologia, saremo felici di conoscerti.

Sede di lavoro: Roma, in presenza full time

Contratto: Tempo indeterminato

RAL: 38.000/40.000 €

Risk Consulting is looking for candidate to join our Risk Advanced Technology team as Senior Consultant based in Rome for a hybrid role.

Risk Consulting is a management consulting firm that provides risk management services as part of Marsh Risk, a leader in insurance brokerage and head of the international Marsh Group, a group of expertise in strategic and management consulting, reinsurance, human capital, and investments (Oliver Wyman, Guy Carpenter, Mercer).

The Risk Advanced Technology practice develops innovative risk management services using advanced technologies (Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Process Mining, and Business Intelligence) to support leading public and private organizations.

We count on you to:


Support clients in developing integrated risk management frameworks and in the digital transformation of risk management processes;
Analyze, map, and redesign business processes to identify inefficiencies, pain points, control gaps, and automation opportunities, with a particular focus on AI-enabled transformation initiatives;
Support clients in the assessment and reengineering of operational and control processes, leveraging AI, process mining, intelligent automation, and advanced analytics solutions. Gather and formalize business and functional requirements, translating client needs into actionable process improvement roadmaps and technology-enabled solutions;
Contribute to the design and implementation of AI use cases aimed at improving process efficiency, strengthening controls, reducing manual activities, and enhancing decision-making;
Work closely with business, risk, compliance, audit, and technology stakeholders to ensure that process transformation initiatives are aligned with governance, regulatory, and internal control requirements;
Support the execution of diagnostic assessments, gap analyses, and target operating model designs in the context of business transformation and innovation programs;
Contribute to project delivery across the full lifecycle, from current-state analysis and solution design to implementation support, testing, go-live, and change management;
Mentor junior team members and contribute to the development of internal methodologies, assets, and thought leadership on AI-driven process transformation;
Build Business Intelligence and Advanced Analytics solutions for dynamic reporting, risk monitoring dashboards, and early warning systems;
Interact with clients and all stakeholders involved in the projects, presenting results and strategic recommendations clearly and effectively.


What you need to have: 


Master’s degree or higher in Management or Industrial Engineering, with excellent academic results;
Proven experience in consulting projects with proven expertise in the following areas:

Good understanding of AI-enabled business transformation, including the application of Artificial Intelligence, intelligent automation, process mining, or analytics to improve business processes
Consulting projects focused on business process analysis, process reengineering, operating model review, or transformation initiative
Solid experience in gathering business and functional requirements, process mapping, drafting functional specifications, and supporting the implementation of technology-driven solutions
Experience in interacting with multiple stakeholders, facilitating workshops, and presenting complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Strong project management attitude, attention to detail, and ability to manage workstreams autonomously in a client-facing environment
Excellent knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; familiarity with process mapping and workflow documentation tools is a plus
Fluent Italian and English, both written and spoken


What makes you stand out:


Experience in AI transformation projects with a specific focus on process optimization, redesign, governance, and adoption
Knowledge of LLM models: prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), orchestration of AI agents and copilots, evaluation of model performance, and application of guardrails and governance mechanisms to ensure reliability, explainability, and compliance in business processes
Experience in internal controls, internal audit, compliance, or assurance-related projects, as well as familiarity with the most widely used risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 31000, COSO Framework), with the ability to connect process reengineering initiatives to control frameworks and verification needs
Knowledge of process mining tools and methodologies for identifying bottlenecks, deviations, and improvement opportunities
Familiarity with risk and control frameworks, governance models, and operating models in regulated or complex environments
Experience in projects involving the review of end-to-end processes within finance, operations, procurement, compliance, or risk functions
Knowledge of low-code / no-code and workflow automation platforms (e.g., Power Platform, Power Automate) and their use in process transformation initiatives
Relevant certifications in process improvement, project management, audit, or risk management
Knowledge of advanced Data Visualization tools (Power BI, DAX, Qlik) and Data Management tools (e.g., Azure, SQL, SAS)


Why join our team:


An international, cross-business network with leaders in Strategy, Risk, and People professional services
The opportunity to design and apply innovative risk solutions in practice for use by the Italian Public Administration (e.g., central government bodies and public-owned companies) and the private sector


What we offer:


The position is offered on a permanent basis.
We propose a gross annual salary starting from € 32.000 for a full-time position. Depending on experience, skills and qualifications, we are willing to consider compensation above the starting salary. Variable remuneration may be granted in accordance with company policy. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract.
The National Collective Bargaining Agreement (NCBA) applied is "Terziario, Distribuzione e Servizi”. The contractual level, together with the applicable terms and conditions, will be determined in line with the experience and professional profile of the candidate selected through the recruitment process.
Attractive benefits offered, including insurance coverages, supplementary pension plan, facultative health assistance, meal vouchers, flexible benefits, optional stock purchase plan, smart working policy, learning programs and well-being initiatives. Further details will be shared during the selection process or directly in the employment contract


Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Title: Risk Analyst on Asset Management Activities
HTML:
The Group Risk Operating Framework (Group ROF) is part of the Group Enterprise Risk Management function which reports directly to the Group CRO. Its mission is to ensure that the risk management framework is operating effectively across Generali organization.


In order to strengthen its capabilities and reinforce the steering and control on Asset Management (AM) business, the Group ROF function is looking for a Risk Analyst whose main mission will be to support the setting-up of specific controls on AM activities, among which:

  • identification of relevant Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) to be monitored at fund level, e.g. SCR, credit default, market volatility, etc. depending on the specific asset classes being considered;
  • analyses at fund level on the evolution of such KRIs vs predefined model portfolios;
  • definition of early warning indicators to anticipate the potential impacts on the Insurance Portfolios of relevant deviations from such model portfolios;
  • strengthening the monitoring on particular asset classes such as Alternative funds, ABS (e.g. CLOs, MBS, etc.) and Real Assets funds (e.g. Private Debt, Private and Infrastructure Equity, Real Estate);
  • reporting and disclosure to Senior Management and/or to relevant Administrative Management or Supervisory Boards.


The candidate will ideally also be involved in the existing Group risk management frameworks to investigate and deep-dive connections and implications with the main risks to which the Insurance portfolios are subject to; more in details, the candidate would support the following enhancement of the Investment Risk framework:

  • mapping of the AuM managed by Group AM Companies, distinguishing between Generali Portfolios (Own, Shared, Customer Risk) and Third-Party;
  • partaking to the definition of appropriate risk-adjusted KPIs, considering the risk indicators adopted to monitor investment risks within the Insurance Portfolios;
  • follow-up on the effective riskiness of specific investment initiatives vs approved proposals.


Requirements

  • Bachelor degree in Economics, Finance or Quantitative disciplines;
  • At least 3-5 years of relevant working experience in asset management and/or in financial institutions, preferably in Investments and/or Risk Management (or other similar experience, e.g. Business Consulting);
  • Understanding of Asset Management industry practices and regulation; understanding of financial markets and related risks (market, credit, counterparty, liquidity, sustainability, valuation, operational and reputational), and familiarity with risk management methodologies;
  • Working knowledge of investments in private assets instruments (e.g. Private Debt, Private Equity, Real Estate), risk-return profiles, valuation methodologies, etc.;
  • Familiarity with Risk Management softwares (e.g. Risk Metrics, Liquidity Metrics) and/or Alternative Assets data providers (e.g. Preqin, Quantyx) is a plus;
  • Working knowledge of VBA, Matlab (or other equivalent programming language).


Soft Skills:

  • Proactive approach with strong learning ability and collaborative mindset;
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to interact with different stakeholders;
  • Ability to gather information, re-organize it, analyze it and report it in an effective way;
  • Resistance to stress and reactive to tight timelines and deadline requirements;
  • Second European foreign language such as French, German or Spanish is a plus.


What we offer

We offer employment at the V level with the relevant salary, in accordance with the CCNL ANIA for non-executive employees and the Generali Group Company Agreement.


Gross annual salary ranging between 39K€ and 49K€. The final offer will be aligned with the candidate’s professional experience, technical and soft skills relevant to the role, and may include an individual variable component.


We also offer:

  • Smart working and flexible hours
  • Corporate welfare system
  • Meal vouchers
  • Supplementary health insurance and discounted insurance policies
  • Well-being initiatives
  • Training and development
  • Structured continuous learning paths (technical and managerial)
  • Career development programs within the Group
  • Access to learning platforms and internal mobility opportunities, including international opportunities.


Why work with us

Joining Generali means becoming part of an international Group with a strong heritage and a forward-looking vision, where people are at the center of our sustainable growth strategy.

We foster a responsible, inclusive, and innovation-driven work environment, where everyone can contribute to creating value for customers, society, and the communities in which we operate.

We believe that diversity, equity and inclusion are essential to building a stronger culture and driving sustainable growth.

At Generali, you will find opportunities to grow through continuous learning, career development paths, and internal mobility across the Group.

We recognize talent and merit, and support flexibility as a key enabler of well-being and a sustainable work-life balance.

Working with us means sharing strong values and taking on meaningful challenges together to build a safer and more sustainable future every day.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, Generali evaluates all applications based exclusively on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including skills, experience and potential, ensuring fairness and transparency throughout the selection process.


Company Profile

Generali Group Head Office is the guidelining unit of the Generali Group, one of the largest global insurance and asset management providers. Established in 1831, Generali is present in over 50 countries in the world, with a total premium income of € 82.5 billion in 2023. With around 82,000 employees serving 70 million customers, the Group has a leading position in Europe and a growing presence in Asia and Latin America. At the heart of Generali’s strategy is its Lifetime Partner commitment to customers, achieved through innovative and personalised solutions, best-in-class customer experience and its digitalised global distribution capabilities. The Group has fully embedded sustainability into all strategic choices, with the aim to create value for all stakeholders while building a fairer and more resilient society.

Descrizione del ruolo Il/la Buyer Senior Analyst opererà con sede di lavoro a Greater Rome Metropolitan Area, in un ruolo full time in sede, occupandosi delle attività quotidiane di analisi e gestione degli acquisti per IQ Medical - Healthcare Services & Solutions. La persona analizzerà l'andamento dei costi e dei mercati, monitorando le performance dei fornitori (KPI), individuando tendenze o anomalie nei dati di spesa (spend analysis), creando report per supportare la Direzione Acquisti nelle trattative. Tra le competenze chiave dovrà possedere padronanza assoluta di Excel, capacità di interpretare grandi quantità di dati (data analytics), problem solving e una buona comprensione delle dinamiche di business. La risorsa si dedicherà alla raccolta e analisi dei dati relativi a fornitori, prezzi e volumi, supportando la definizione delle strategie di approvvigionamento nel settore sanitario. Il/la Buyer Senior Analyst collaborerà strettamente con i reparti commerciali, logistici, customer service e amministrativi per garantire continuità di fornitura, ottimizzazione dei costi e conformità alle normative di settore. È richiesta una forte attenzione ai dettagli, capacità di lavorare con scadenze e un approccio analitico orientato al miglioramento continuo dei processi di acquisto. 




Qualifiche

Il/la candidato/a dovrebbe possedere solide competenze di analisi e capacità di interpretare indicatori di performance.
Costituiscono titolo preferenziale una laurea in ingegneria biomedica o in discipline economiche, ingegneria gestionale o affini, buona conoscenza di excel e dei principali software gestionali, oltre a capacità di comunicazione efficace e lavoro in team.
Si richiede minimo 3 anni di esperienza nella funzione di buyer, preferibilmente nell’ambito sanitario

Laurea e/o Master, preferibilmente in ambito economico o scientifico.
Esperienza manageriale maturata nel mondo retail.
Forte orientamento al cliente e passione per il settore.
Capacità di analizzare e ottimizzare i processi di negozio.
Approccio fortemente data-driven e capacità di utilizzare il dato a supporto dei processi decisionali.
Esperienza nella gestione di dati di produttività e KPI commerciali di negozio.
Leadership collaborativa, capacità di costruire relazioni basate sulla fiducia e apertura al feedback.
